description: Election Commission - Declare that K. S. I. A. Fernando as a Member of the Negombo M.C.
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Negombo Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically details the electoral process for replacing a resigned member, including the nomination by a political party and the official declaration by the Returning Officer. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
